evals.name: feature-add-staged
evals.prompt: I just staged the implementation of a new --json flag on our CLI plus its unit tests and a tiny README mention. Update the changelog for me.
evals.expected_output: One Added bullet describing the --json flag (feature-level, not per-file). Updates [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md without bumping versions or committing.

evals.name: mixed-fix-and-deps
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the staged diff includes a bug fix in src/auth.ts plus an updated package-lock.json. Produces one Fixed bullet for the auth fix and one Changed bullet 'Updated dependencies.' for the lockfile. No file-level noise.

evals.name: missing-changelog-create
evals.prompt: summarize my staged changes for the changelog
evals.expected_output: Detects no CHANGELOG.md at repo root, asks before creating one, scaffolds the Keep-a-Changelog template only after confirmation, then proceeds with the summary into [Unreleased].
